selection_rule: On the dev split only: highest lift in P(further severe drop within H days) among configs firing on 0.3%-1.0% of instrument-days; on ties within 0.2 lift, the simplest rule (fewest active conditions). Held-out scored once, after this file was written.

volatility_halt.definition: latest bar true range / mean true range of the 20 prior bars

data_notes: Crypto: Binance archive daily, LUNA clipped at 2022-05-28 (Terra 2.0 reuses the symbol). Equity: Yahoo daily split-adjusted, index ETFs excluded from scoring. FX: Yahoo daily, every pair also scored inverted; USDCNY/USDARS/USDRUB excluded (managed or unreliable); single-bar spikes >8% that reverse >6% next bar removed as bad ticks.
